documents.title: Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of AGM
Disclosures under Reg. 10(6) of SEBI (SAST) Regulations, 2011
Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Notice of Postal Ballot

analysis.summary: Kovai Medical Center and Hospital Limited reported financial performance for the year 2025-26 with operating income of Rs. 1,58,563.68 Lakhs and profit after tax of Rs. 24,446.00 Lakhs, driven by strong occupancy and higher ARPOB. Management announced infrastructural expansions, including the board approval for a 300-bed Paediatric Hospital at the main center premises with construction expected to commence during the second quarter of 2026. The company highlighted ongoing technological advancements, clinical milestones, and the ongoing execution of academic healthcare programs.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that global healthcare demand continues to rise driven by aging populations, rapid medical technology advancements, and increasing patient expectations.
demand_outlook.quote: As global healthcare demand continues to rise—driven by aging populations, rapid advancements in medical technology, and increasing patient expectations—healthcare providers are under mounting pressure to develop cutting-edge hospitals, clinics, and medical campuses within tighter budgets and accelerated timelines.

demand_outlook.claim: The medical college experienced high demand for admissions with all seats being filled.
demand_outlook.quote: Their reputation has become so esteemed that there is now high demand for admission to this prestigious medical school, with all seats being filled.

demand_outlook.claim: Specialized departments like cardiology, oncology, neurology, and orthopaedics are continuously patronized by patients, culminating in increased demand for advanced treatments.
demand_outlook.quote: specialized departments such as cardiology, oncology, neurology, and orthopaedics are continuously being patronised by the highly satisfied patients culminating in to the increased demand for such advanced treatments.

capex_expansion.claim: The board approved the construction of a 300-bed Paediatric Hospital at the main center premises.
capex_expansion.quote: The board has approved for constructing 300 bed Paediatric Hospital at the main center premises and the work may commence during the second quarter 2026.

capex_expansion.claim: The hospital plans to add another 100 beds in the main campus.
capex_expansion.quote: We will add another 100 beds in the main campus.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is planning a 300-400 bed hospital in Chennai.
capex_expansion.quote: In addition we are planning a 300-400 bed hospital in Chennai.

capex_expansion.claim: The OP block for the new hospital will be ready for operation by the end of the year.
capex_expansion.quote: The OP block will be ready for operation by this year end.

capex_expansion.claim: The company made an investment of 496.00 Lakhs in advanced medical equipment during the year 2024-25.
capex_expansion.quote: As part of its ongoing commitment to adopt cutting-edge medical technologies, your company made a significant investment of ₹ 496.00 Lakhs in advanced medical equipment during the year 2024–25.

capex_expansion.claim: Total investment in equipment during the year 2024-25 amounts to 3,358.36 Lakhs.
capex_expansion.quote: Investment in equipment during the year 2024-25 amounts to ₹ 3,358.36 Lakhs.

capex_expansion.claim: The company invested 5,239.02 Lakhs in equipment during the year 2023-24.
capex_expansion.quote: Investment in equipment during the year 2023-24 amounts to ` 5239.02 Lakhs.

capex_expansion.claim: Newly inaugurated super-speciality facilities at the Sulur branch now have added cath lab and MRI facilities.
capex_expansion.quote: The newly inaugurated super-speciality facilities at the Sulur branch of Kovai Medical Center now have added cath lab and MRI facilities.

margins_costs.claim: The hospital posted a robust EBITDA margin of 29% and a sustained PAT margin of 15%.
margins_costs.quote: Your hospital has posted a robust EBITDA margin of 29%, which is excellent compared to the current industry standards, and has shown a sustained PAT (Profit After Tax) margin of 15%.

margins_costs.claim: The profit margin for the financial year 2024-25 was 15%.
Solar power generation enabled the company to save approximately 31% on its annual power bill.
margins_costs.quote: This practice has enabled your company to save approximately 31% on the annual power bill.

margins_costs.claim: Biogas produced from decomposed biodegradable food waste is used for captive consumption in the hospital canteen, reducing LPG costs.
margins_costs.quote: Through this system, biodegradable food waste are decomposed, and biogas is produced for captive consumption in the hospital canteen. This initiative not only effectively manages waste but also results in reduced LPG costs, contributing to both environmental sustainability and cost savings.

orders_capacity.claim: The hospital operates as a 2000 bed hospital.
orders_capacity.quote: Our Hospital is a 2000 bed hospital.

orders_capacity.claim: The total strength of employees of the company as on March 31, 2024 was 5,286.
orders_capacity.quote: The total strength of the employees of the Company as on 31st March 2024 was 5286.

capital_allocation.claim: The board recommended a dividend of 15 per share for the financial year 2025-26.
capital_allocation.quote: Based on Company’s performance, the Board of Directors are pleased to recommend a dividend of ₹15/- per share (150%) for the Financial Year 2025-26 subject to the approval of the members.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board has recommended a 100% dividend.
The dividend on equity shares involves a cash outflow of 1,094.23 lakhs.
capital_allocation.quote: The dividend on equity shares, if approved by the members would involve a cash outflow of ₹ 1,094.23 lakhs.

capital_allocation.claim: The company allocated 271.25 Lakhs towards implementing Corporate Social Responsibility activities.
capital_allocation.quote: During the year under review in pursuance of the recommendations of the CSR Committee, the Company had commitment of ` 271.25 Lakhs being 2% of the last three years’ average net profit of the Company towards implementing the CSR activities.

capital_allocation.claim: The company has not accepted any public or member deposits during the year.
capital_allocation.quote: As per Section 73 of the Companies Act 2013 read with the Companies (Acceptance of Deposits), Rules 2014, the company has not accepted any deposits from the public or its members during the year.

risks_headwinds.claim: Constructing healthcare infrastructure presents unique challenges including stringent regulatory compliance, seamless technology integration, and the need for uninterrupted operations.
risks_headwinds.quote: Constructing healthcare infrastructure presents unique challenges, including stringent regulatory compliance, seamless integration of advanced technologies, and the need for uninterrupted, round-the-clock operations.

risks_headwinds.claim: Substantial investments in state-of-the-art facilities and cutting-edge technologies have put pressure on cash flows.
risks_headwinds.quote: Significant investments are required to attract and retain qualified medical professionals, technicians, and skilled medical staff which has put pressure on our cash flow.

risks_headwinds.claim: The shortage of skilled medical professionals is a pressing issue impacting institutions and their ability to deliver quality care effectively.
risks_headwinds.quote: The shortage of skilled medical professionals is a pressing issue in the healthcare industry, impacting institutions like KMCH and their ability to deliver quality care effectively.

risks_headwinds.claim: Compliance costs, administrative burdens, and lengthy approval processes present significant challenges to the healthcare industry.
risks_headwinds.quote: Regulatory requirements present significant challenges to the healthcare industry. Compliance costs, administrative burdens, lengthy approval processes, and potential legal consequences for non-compliance all work as a deterrent to the organization, demanding substantial investments of time and money to meet the legal requirements.

management_commitments.claim: Construction of the 300-bed Paediatric Hospital may commence during the second quarter of 2026.
management_commitments.quote: The board has approved for constructing 300 bed Paediatric Hospital at the main center premises and the work may commence during the second quarter 2026.

management_commitments.claim: The company will add another 100 beds in the main campus.
management_commitments.quote: We will add another 100 beds in the main campus.

management_commitments.claim: The OP block will be ready for operation by the year end.
management_commitments.quote: The OP block will be ready for operation by this year end.

management_commitments.claim: The company is planning to start a new hospital in Chennai.
management_commitments.quote: We are planning to start a new hospital in Chennai.

management_commitments.claim: The upcoming neurosciences center will be the first of its kind in the region, equipped with state-of-the-art facilities.
management_commitments.quote: The upcoming neurosciences center will be the first of its kind in this region, equipped with state-of-the-art facilities.

management_commitments.claim: Management is focused on expanding the Department of Oncology and addressing existing gaps in medical care within the region.
management_commitments.quote: We are also focused on expanding the Department of Oncology and addressing any existing gaps in medical care within this region.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
